{{recipesummary|category=Pasta recipes|servings=6|time=1 hour|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], separated 
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Ricotta|ricotta cheese]] OR shredded [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]] OR shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly-ground white [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
*½ cup heavy [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
*~1000 g cooked lasagne [[Cookbook:Noodle|noodles]]
*1 ½ cups [[Cookbook:Italian Tomato Sauce|Italian Tomato Sauce]]

== Procedure ==
#In a large spotlessly clean stainless steel bowl, whip egg whites to stiff peaks and set aside.
#Combine egg yolks, cheese, salt, pepper, and heavy cream.
#Gently [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] egg whites into cheese mixture.
#Lay half the cooked noodles in the bottom of a roasting pan. Add a layer of tomato sauce on top, then a layer of the cheese mixture. Repeat this step for a second layer of noodles/tomato/cheese. The last layer should be cheese.
#Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] and [[Cookbook:Bake|bake]] at 375°F for 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 20 minutes.
#Remove from oven, and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.

steps.text: In a large spotlessly clean stainless steel bowl, whip egg whites to stiff peaks and set aside.
Combine egg yolks, cheese, salt, pepper, and heavy cream.
Gently fold egg whites into cheese mixture.

Lay half the cooked noodles in the bottom of a roasting pan. Add a layer of tomato sauce on top, then a layer of the cheese mixture. Repeat this step for a second layer of noodles/tomato/cheese. The last layer should be cheese.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 20 minutes.
Remove from oven, and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.
